text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll answer them...! I will, I will! I'm 
going to win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's me— The star of the show could 
never be anyone else!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Unable to eat, ...unfulfilled, into my 
empty and bitterly cold body...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The heat... The heat is――!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can still run. Still, still, still... 
even faster!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even more—!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the first time, she—who had always 
stoically and quietly strived to fulfill 
her self-imposed mission— revealed a 
glimpse of—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a heat blazing with brilliant 
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—It's still... burning hot.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(So painful it felt like my throat and 
chest were burning to cinders.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the same heat I felt during my 
debut? ...Your heat?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (That's... right, isn't it? Tell me—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she missed out on 1st place, Admire 
Vega still achieved a splendid result in 
the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her appetite, which had been a concern, 
seemed to be recovering. It looked like we 
could smoothly continue preparations for 
the next big stage, the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for her, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
...Ayabe, we're done with today's menu, 
you know?

...Ayabe, we're done with today's menu, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah— Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...No good. At this rate, I still won't 
reach Opera-chan or Ayabe-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Derby of all races... In the Derby! 
I'll beat those two and...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...By the Derby... I wonder how fast 
she'll become?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What kind of race... will be next—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading out. Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, slowly but surely, 
within her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like something akin to a "rivalry" 
is beginning to sprout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Dedicate victory to her little sister." 
That was an immensely important goal to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if in the midst of running, 
Admire Vega herself can also find rivals 
in the race and discover the joy of 
competing—
choice_data_list:
(That's a really wonderful thing, isn't 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home one day, I suddenly look 
up at the sky and wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, where's Admire Vega—
choice_data_list:
I wonder if she's been able to go 
stargazing lately?

I wonder if she's been able to go 
stargazing lately?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the cloudy spring skies that 
continued for a while after that, training 
for the Nippon Derby began—
